experiences.company: Umoja Savings & Credit Cooperative Society Limited
experiences.summary:
Coordinated the daily operations of a community-based savings and credit cooperative, including record keeping, member onboarding, loan appraisal and repayment follow-up. Introduced a simple spreadsheet-based bookkeeping system that reduced reconciliation errors and improved transparency for members.
Trained twelve volunteers on customer service, anti-fraud procedures and conflict resolution, and represented the cooperative at district-level stakeholder meetings with microfinance institutions, non-governmental organisations and local government officials.

top_skills.description: Control and manage budgets and financial resources providing capable stewardship in financial administration.
Keep track of and finalise all formal documents representing the financial transactions of a business or project.

Lead and guide employees through a process in which they are taught the necessary skills for the perspective job. Organise activities aimed at introducing the work and systems or improving the performance of individuals and groups in organisational settings.
Take ownership of the handling of all complaints and disputes showing empathy and understanding to achieve resolution.
Assess the creditworthiness of loan applicants by analysing their financial situation, collateral and repayment capacity.
